issues.detail: The Hebrew 'לְאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי' means 'for Ethan the Ezrahite' (a proper name), but the Chinese renders it as '屬亞薩拉喜人以探' which introduces '亞薩拉喜人' (Asa/Asaph? unclear) and misidentifies the person; the name 'Ethan' is present but the patronymic/gentilic is garbled and an extra name '亞薩' appears, changing the identity.
